definitions.explanation: A single written or spoken sentence. Used when referring to the structure or content of written text.

examples.japanese: {一文|いちぶん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{長|なが}すぎる。
{一文|いちぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{短|みじか}く→短い：00510_mijikai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧やすく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Making each sentence shorter makes it easier to read.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一文|いちぶん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{気持|きも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧こめられて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: His feelings are packed into the last sentence of this letter.

notes:
USAGE:
{一文|いちぶん} refers to a single sentence in writing. It is commonly used when discussing writing style, editing, or text structure.
Do not confuse with {一文|いちもん} (one mon — a tiny amount of money), which has a different reading and meaning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一文|いちぶん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧ (a sentence is long)
- {一文|いちぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{短|みじか}く→短い：00510_mijikai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to shorten a sentence)
- ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一文|いちぶん} (the last sentence)
- {一文|いちぶん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{言|い}い{表|あらわ}す (to express in a single sentence)
